Name: Gutter
Description: Rain running along a street's gutter against the kerb (RunningWaterSpec.KerbGutter, RunningWaterSynth): fifteen metres of it above a drain, fed by the run-off from its half of the road and pavement. Silent in dry weather; fills over a few minutes when it rains and runs on after. Heard from places along its length, which lies along the entity's own x axis: turn the entity to lay it along the kerb. Not a recording and not a loop.
